articles.title: Trump Parades War in Chilling Truth Social Frenzy
articles.description: Jonathan Ernst / REUTERS Donald Trump bragged about the resumption of his brutal war on Iran—after waking up in neighboring Turkey. The 80-year-old is in Ankara for a NATO summit dominated by discussion of Russia’s aggression in Ukraine, Trump’s demands for NATO allies to boost defense spending, and his on-off threats to seize Greenland. The president’s ill-fated war on Iran will also be a talking point. Despite the two sides signing a Memorandum of Understanding aimed at a ceasefire, the deal is on shaky ground after the U.S. completed a military strike on over 80 targets in Iran, according to a statement released on Tuesday from Central Command. Read more at The Daily Beast.
